Gli altri badge sono elaborazioni grafiche nello stesso stile.</p>
```{=html}
  </div>

<script>
(function(){
  var chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".os-chip"));
  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".os-card"));
  var search = document.getElementById("os-search");
  var count = document.getElementById("os-count");
  var empty = document.getElementById("os-empty");
  if(!cards.length) return;
  var active = [];

  function update(){
    var q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var n = 0;
    cards.forEach(function(card){
      var has = card.getAttribute("data-practices").split(" ");
      var ok = active.every(function(p){ return has.indexOf(p) >= 0; }) &&
        (!q || card.getAttribute("data-search").indexOf(q) >= 0);
      card.hidden = !ok;
      if(ok) n++;
    });
    count.textContent = n;
    empty.hidden = n > 0;
    chips.forEach(function(chip){
      var f = chip.getAttribute("data-filter");
      var on = f === "all" ? active.length === 0 : active.indexOf(f) >= 0;
      chip.classList.toggle("is-active", on);
      chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on ? "true" : "false");
    });
  }

  chips.forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var f = chip.getAttribute("data-filter");
      if(f === "all") active = [];
      else if(active.indexOf(f) >= 0) active.splice(active.indexOf(f), 1);
      else active.push(f);
      update();
    });
  });
  search.addEventListener("input", update);

  // Dialogs: plain-language summaries (one per card, linkable as #sintesi-<id>)
  // and badge explanations (#badge-<key>, opened from card or summary badges).
  // Only summaries are reflected in the URL hash.
  function isSummary(id){ return id.indexOf("sintesi-") === 0; }
  function openDialog(id){
    var d = document.getElementById(id);
    if(!d || d.open || !d.showModal) return;
    d.showModal();
    if(isSummary(id)) history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + id);
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-dialog]"), function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ openDialog(btn.getAttribute("data-dialog")); });
  });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".os-dialog"), function(d){
    d.querySelector(".os-dialog-close").addEventListener("click", function(){ d.close(); });
    d.addEventListener("click", function(e){ if(e.target === d) d.close(); });
    d.addEventListener("close", function(){
      if(isSummary(d.id)) history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search);
    });
  });
  if(location.hash.indexOf("#sintesi-") === 0) openDialog(location.hash.slice(1));
})();
</script>
```
